messages:
alex: Kicking off v2.3.1 regional rollout — US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 22:00-23:30 PT. Pin EU to v2.3.0 if any thermal/latency spike. Asking for quick capacity checks + smoke test owners. @ben you're lead US, @carla EU, @dave APAC.

deploy-bot: Canary started in us slice-1 (version v2.3.1). Traffic ramp policy: 5% -> 25% per 10m. Logs: https://deploys/redwood/1758884320. /deploy status: canary=us:10% health=ok.

ben: US warm pool is at 2.0x baseline after warmup. p95 latency steady ~92ms, QPS +10% relative to baseline. No error-rate uptick in app or model. smoke tests (smoke/us/v2.3.1) all green :thumbsup:.

carla: EU warm pool only at 0.7x expected due to delayed pre-warm in lon-zone-2. p95 climbed to 140ms on that zone. I'd prefer to hold EU rollout and pin until warm pool >=1.0x or we bump burst reserve.

alex: OK hold EU. @deploy-bot pin europe to v2.3.0 and set traffic-slice back to 0 for v2.3.1. We do not want partial EU traffic leaking to new version.

deploy-bot: Action: pinned europe -> v2.3.0 (user alex). Canary in US continues. APAC scheduled to start at +40m. Commands recorded: `rbctl pin --region eu --version v2.3.0` `deploy status --canary us`.

dave: APAC warm pool: tokyo 1.1x ok, sydney 0.6x behind. I'll delay APAC by ~30m and run prewarm script + warm-surge. ETA 25m.

maria: Release notes draft: v2.3.1 fixes KV-cache eviction bug and kernel-selection tweak for long context. Callout: EU rollout paused/pinned due to warm pool; see release board.

ops-oncall: Reminder of rollback criteria: sustained errors >0.5% for 10m OR p95 >25% vs baseline. If triggered: immediate rollback, escalate to #eng-sre and page #oncall. Keep deadman timers on.

carla: re-running EU prewarm. warm pool now 0.98x; kicking off smoke set `smoke/eu/v2.3.1` (small chat and reranker tests).

deploy-bot: smoke/eu/v2.3.1 FAILED: chat-reranker mismatch test  (error rate 0.7% for that test). Full failure log: https://ci/redwood/smoke/1758884320. Recommendation: keep EU pinned to v2.3.0 until root cause is clear.

ben: US canary still green at 50% ramp. Suggest we pause further ramp at 50% for 15m to observe model metrics (alignment + latency).

alex: Pause US ramp at 50% for 15m. EU remains pinned. @dave do APAC prewarm and stand by — start canary only after US observe window ends and EU remains pinned.

dave: Sydney prewarm finished, warm pool sydney=1.05x. Ready to start canary when you give the go. Planning 10% traffic only.

maria: I'll update release notes: 'EU rollout paused due to pre-warm; pinned to v2.3.0 until verified. US canary paused at 50% for observation. APAC tentative 10% start pending US window.'

alex: Sounds good. I'll update the deployment board and create a short follow-up checklist if EU needs rollback. Everyone leave monitoring alerts unmuted and set the 10m deadman timer. Thanks.
